name: Mexican Quinoa
subtitle: One pan, discovered by Tess
notes: Enjoyed by the Weyands. We like to add meat, either chopped chicken or beef with taco seasoning, which you can prepare while the quinoa is cooking.

items: 1 × 14.5 oz can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 × 14.5 oz can fire roasted diced tomatoes
Salt and black pepper to taste

steps.title: Saute the aromatics
steps.body: Heat **1 Tbsp olive oil** in a large skillet and add **2 cloves garlic, minced** and **1 jalapeño, diced**. Cook for one minute.

steps.title: Add the quinoa
steps.body: Add **1 cup uncooked quinoa**, **1 cup chicken stock**, **1 × 14.5 oz can corn, drained**, **1 × 14.5 oz can black beans, drained and rinsed**, **1 × 14.5 oz can fire roasted diced tomatoes**, **1 tsp chili powder**, **½ tsp cumin**, and salt and black pepper to taste. Stir it all together.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.body: Put a lid on and cook on medium-low heat for 15 minutes, until the quinoa is cooked.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Take it off the heat and add **juice of 1 lime**, **1 avocado, diced** and **2 Tbsp chopped cilantro**.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.body: Top with sour cream and salsa (if you want). Then eat it straight with a spoon, fill a burrito with it, or scoop it up with tortilla chips.
